The following is an ATF transliteration of the Old Babylonian Akkadian tablet UET 5, 81 / BM 131236. Translate it directly into natural, idiomatic modern English. Write it as a coherent letter rather than a line-by-line gloss. Do not reproduce or paraphrase an existing published translation. Do not silently invent or restore damaged content; mark materially uncertain passages with brackets and provide brief notes afterward only where an interpretive choice significantly affects the meaning. Preserve the divisions `obverse`, `reverse`, and `left edge`. Output only the translation and any necessary notes.
